title: Add RecipesActiveFilters model and matching rules
description: Introduce a focused filter-state value type for selected tags, optional prep/cook limits, optional difficulty, and optional course. Include active-filter counting plus recipe-matching behavior that encodes the spec's OR-within-tags and AND-across-axes semantics.
acceptance_criteria: A dedicated filter-state type exists with fields for tags, cook time, prep time, difficulty, and course.
The type exposes an active-filter count used by the toolbar badge.
Recipe matching excludes recipes missing `cook time` or `prep time` when the corresponding max filter is active and compares difficulty/course case-insensitively.

handoff_summary.completed: Introduced `RecipesActiveFilters` struct (`Equatable`, `Sendable`) with five filter axes: `selectedTags: Set<String>`, `maxCookTimeMinutes: Int?`, `maxPrepTimeMinutes: Int?`, `difficulty: String?`, `course: String?`. Exposes `activeFilterCount` (one per non-empty axis) and `isEmpty` computed properties. `matches(_ recipe: Recipe) -> Bool` encodes OR-within-tags (via `Set.isDisjoint`), cook/prep time exclusion when filter is active but metadata key is absent or over the max, and case-insensitive equality for difficulty/course (falling back to both key variants `"cook time"`/`"cook_time"`, `"prep time"`/`"prep_time"`, `"meal type"`/`"meal_type"`). Added `static let inactive` convenience. Build: `** BUILD SUCCEEDED **`.
handoff_summary.remaining: Downstream beads must wire this type into RecipesListView (@SceneStorage state, filter sheet bindings, toolbar badge) and RecipesFilterSheet, and add unit tests (RecipesActiveFiltersTests.swift).
handoff_summary.risks: None material. `RecipesActiveFilters` is a pure value type with no I/O. Downstream view beads may conflict if they also touch RecipesListView simultaneously; coordinate on that file's scope.
handoff_summary.next_action: Wire RecipesActiveFilters into RecipesListView (@SceneStorage state), present RecipesFilterSheet from toolbar, apply matches predicate to filtered entries, and show badge with activeFilterCount.
handoff_summary.conflict_risks: Downstream beads touching RecipesListView.swift should coordinate to avoid merge conflicts on that single file.
handoff_summary.design_decisions: Used `Set.isDisjoint(with:)` for tag OR semantics — cleaner than `contains(where:)`. Added `isEmpty` convenience alongside `activeFilterCount` for filter-sheet Clear button guard. Included `static let inactive` for a clean default-state expression site. Both key variants tried for time fields (`"cook time"`/`"cook_time"`, etc.) matching the existing RecipeStatStrip fallback pattern.
handoff_summary.test_coverage_notes: Unit tests for RecipesActiveFilters.matches(_:) are out of scope for this bead; the tester bead should cover tag OR semantics, time max boundary cases (nil metadata excluded, boundary value included/excluded), AND composition across axes, and empty-filter pass-through.
handoff_summary.known_limitations: Course matching looks up `"meal type"` and `"meal_type"` but does not normalise case of the stored value — values are compared case-insensitively via localizedCaseInsensitiveCompare, which is correct per spec. Difficulty is treated the same way.

conflict_risks: Downstream beads touching RecipesListView.swift should coordinate to avoid merge conflicts on that single file.

execution_history.summary: Created `CookbookApp/Recipes/RecipesActiveFilters.swift` with the filter-state value type, active-filter count, and recipe-matching predicate. Build confirmed passing.
